id.description: This value uniquely identifies the record within its declared entity and version scope.

domain.description: This field names the primary reporting domain for the observation.

taxonomy_id.description: This field references a registered category at the declared taxonomy version.

accepted_taxonomy_ids.description: These registered taxonomy IDs can receive exact-category credit for this unit.

kind.description: This field selects the exact operation or judgment type from the parent enumeration.

weight.description: This integer gives the fixed severity weight from the scoring policy.

correction_eligible.description: This flag states whether the true unit has a correction opportunity.

explanation_eligible.description: This flag states whether the unit has an explanation opportunity.

units.description: These entries contain the reviewed detection opportunities and negative controls.

id.description: This value uniquely identifies the record within its declared entity and version scope.

unit_id.description: This identifier refers to the exact reviewed detection unit.

verdict.description: This field records the resolved semantic outcome for the teacher claim.

duplicate_of.description: This reference identifies the earlier claim with the same supported meaning.

category_id.description: This field contains the mapped category that the teacher explicitly supplied.

correction_supplied.description: This flag records whether the teacher actually supplied a correction.

numerator.description: This field contains the exact numerator of the stored ratio.

denominator.description: This field contains the exact denominator of the stored ratio.

anyOf.description: This fraction gives proposition-derived correction credit.

correction_credit.description: Exact correction credit or null for genuinely unresolved correction meaning. Explanation uncertainty cannot null this field.

explanation_supplied.description: This flag records whether the teacher actually supplied an explanation.

numerator.description: This field contains the exact numerator of the stored ratio.

denominator.description: This field contains the exact denominator of the stored ratio.

anyOf.description: This fraction gives credit from the reviewed explanation propositions.

explanation_credit.description: Independent exact optional explanation credit; null for unresolved/noneligible rubric, never converted into zero to complete a grade.

decisions.description: These records contain one supported outcome for every extracted claim.

detection.description: This flag states whether the task requests error detection.

classification.description: This flag states whether the task requests a category for each detected error.

correction.description: This flag or object describes correction requirements or decisions in its parent contract.

explanation.description: Legacy explanation invitation preference. Under answer-components-v2 explanation is optional and every supplied explanation is assessed independently, regardless of this flag; it does not enter the primary composite.

components.description: These flags select the task components before answer entry.

scoring_policy_version.description: Exact policy frozen on the attempt. New ordinary attempts use answer-components-v2; an explicitly frozen historical/legacy reference uses its original policy, never guessed from explanation presence.
